object_description: compact four-storey square building with layered perimeter spaces
design_condition: The compact new volume is placed at the edge of the sloping site, leaving the hill and much of the landscape open while creating a separate access route and maintaining a respectful distance from the existing buildings.

positive.statement: The chosen location and compact volumetrics respond well to the quality of the flowing landscape.
The new building forms a striking and appropriate structural symbol at the edge of the site.
The outdoor spaces are comprehensibly programmed and harmoniously designed, apart from the entrance square.
The typology provides a flexible modular framework with varied spatial references and cluster-forming possibilities.
The restrained interventions in the existing property are appropriate and respectful.
The compact, prefabricated design offers the prerequisites for good economic indicators.

negative.statement: The new path connection is too tight.
The entrance square is unconvincing in terms of traffic and integration into the neighbourhood.
The widened tree area unnecessarily weakens the flowing landscape space.
The high proportion of glazing creates a challenge for meeting energy requirements.
The meeting between the building structure and the hill topography is barely articulated.
The wooden construction appears somewhat too strong.
